data.title: 双叶理央 · 雨夜的一碗热汤
data.description: 理央穿深红夹克坐在便利店窗边，先把起雾的眼镜轻轻往上推，再用汤匙搅开热汤。折好的伞放在脚边，玻璃映着雨痕，她看见汤面升起的热气，紧绷的眉头终于舒展开。
data.action: 推好起雾的眼镜，用汤匙轻搅热汤。
data.promptProse: Rio Futaba pushes her misted glasses upward before stirring a steaming soup at the convenience-store counter. Her burgundy hooded jacket, grey T-shirt and black trousers accompany a relieved expression. A folded umbrella rests near her shoes, below the seated medium view. Rain streams down the adjacent window, separating the dark exterior from the counter. Soft shop lighting illuminates her eyes and bowl rim, with spoon and sleeve shadows on the surface.
